subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed image bytes require operator.admin, or remain accessible through the existing operator.read-classified artifact download contract?
rationale: Both choices can be internally consistent, but they expose different credential and compatibility boundaries; repository evidence does not establish which permanent contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Retain admin-only managed bytes
options.body: Keep the final gate and prove that ordinary Control UI preview credentials have admin scope while read-only clients and cross-session requests remain denied.

options.title: Use artifact read scope
options.body: Allow operator.read to receive only session-, record-, and transcript-bound managed bytes, matching the existing artifact RPC classification.

options.title: Pause pending capability redesign
options.body: Hold the change if managed bytes need a dedicated capability rather than a special admin exception inside artifacts.download.

recommendation.title: Retain admin-only managed bytes
recommendation.body: Keep the final gate and prove that ordinary Control UI preview credentials have admin scope while read-only clients and cross-session requests remain denied.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent credited work on the managed HTTP handler and lazy Gateway boundary makes this the best available owner-routing candidate.
